title: Partner integrations
descriptionFoods: Delivery partners and POS / marketplace orders per location. Without credentials everything runs in sandbox — nothing is sent.
descriptionRealty: Property portal feeds per office. Without portal credentials feeds are sandbox previews — nothing is sent or published.
sandboxBanner: Sandbox is clearly separate from live: a connection only goes live when its credentials are complete, a connection test passes and you switch it to live.
sampleBanner: Sample data: partners are never contacted in sample mode.
notFetched: Not fetched by the portal yet
webhookUrl: Webhook URL (give this to the partner)
feedUrl: Feed URL (give this to the portal — keep it private)
uberUnavailable: Uber Direct isn’t offered in {country} — deliveries use your own drivers.
readOnly: You can see these connections; changing them needs the “Manage connections” permission.
saved: Saved. New credentials always start in sandbox until tested.

portals.noOffices: No offices in the countries this portal serves.
portals.configureHint: Configure portal credentials per office in Connections.
portals.exported: Export finished: {ok} delivered or in the feed, {invalid} need fixes. {transmitted, select, true {Sent to the portal.} other {Nothing was transmitted (sandbox).}}
portals.errorsEmpty: Every opted-in listing passes the portal checks.
portals.removedNote: Withdrawn, sold and let listings are removed from portals automatically.
